title: Move deformable and smoke collision lookup onto shared indexing
requires: A physical supported GPU, shared Slang build toolchain and public-API test harness
scope: Adopt the shared conservative spatial snapshot for cloth, rope, soft surfaces and smoke obstacle/collision consumers; retain regular-grid smoke field stencils. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Migrate repeated deformable surface refits and relevant collision lookups to one tick epoch and shared leaf/traversal primitives.
Test deforming surface/segment bounds, thin contact, self-contact exclusions, static geometry, topology/generation changes and correction-envelope limits against independent candidates.
Smoke retains its structured pressure/advection grid while obstacle queries share spatial services; no forced BVH replacement of regular-grid numerical operators.
Enforce one update, bounded candidate memory and no per-edge rebuilds; preserve registered mode/capability boundaries.
evidence: PASS: docs/roadmap/evidence/F8-10-deformable-smoke-shared-spatial.json records sparse/full dispatch, memory, correctness, device and portability results
PASS: physical RTX 3050 Ti generated Slang executes cloth/rope/static emission, self/cross filtering, smoke obstacle queries, overflow and stale-identity rejection
PASS: shared service physical CUDA cases cover empty, 30,065-live and 128-live/1,048,576-capacity build/admission/publication/query behavior
PASS: randomized host oracle covers 4,096 deforming segment/triangle states, thin contact, adjacency exclusions, static geometry and one-epoch reuse
PASS: CPU/CUDA/Vulkan builds, SPIR-V validation, Metal/HLSL source compilation, 414 conformance tests, 72 roadmap tests and 176-entry inventory
PASS: structured smoke pressure/advection grid and legacy schedule remain unchanged; public realtime profile remains unsupported pending later F8 tasks
